hero.title: Aerospace-Related Engineering in Finland
hero.subtitle: Experience world-class academic training and global career pathways in Finland with Edu-Hawk Worldwide.

overview: Studying Aerospace Engineering - UG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Can I study Aerospace Engineering in Finland after Class 12?
faq.answer: Yes. Students can pursue English-taught Bachelor

faq.question: Which universities should I consider for aerospace-related engineering?
What is the tuition fee for related engineering courses in Finland?
faq.answer: LUT University lists an annual tuition fee of €12,000 (approx. ₹13.03 lakh). An eligible first-year early-bird discount of €2,000 reduces this to €10,000 (approx. ₹10.86 lakh), with €3,000 annual scholarships in subsequent years.

faq.question: Which subjects should I study in Class 12?
faq.answer: Mathematics and Physics are the mandatory subjects required for engineering studies in Finland, alongside verified English language proficiency.
